name: @bridge/integrations-github
description: GitHub integration — the EGRESS adapter (REST v3 over @bridge/net-guard's guardedFetch, the only file that touches the GitHub API), a fine-grained PAT paste-and-validate flow (no OAuth app registration needed for a single-user connector), and pure intake mapping into DevPilot repo/pull/issue rows. Read-only in D1: no external:send capability.
